title: Chapter 974
paragraphs: Chapter 974
Episode 241. Rescue (3)
Jin and Luna
grasped their swords.
At the moment when the two weapons, Sigmund and Krantel, were imbued with aura, magic, and thunder energy, everyone on the battlefield could detect the two people's energy.
Even those not of Celestial origin, even ordinary people, could feel this power. As soon as the two of them gathered strength, the whole battlefield seemed to vibrate as if it would crumble.
'Is it Jin Lunkandel!?'
'Could it be Jin Lunkandel and Baek Kyung?'
'...Why them?'
The Grand Combat Kings and Luke turned their heads simultaneously.

Jin and Luna's participation was unexpected to everyone. The relentless bombardment from the airborne fortresses and fleets momentarily ceased, and the thunder and sword energy radiating from Luke also subsided.
All but one had stopped fighting and were focusing on the strongest siblings in human history.
[Khaaaaa...!]
Only Eltiyet roared, paying no attention to Jin and Luna, gasping for breath, bleeding from all over his body.
Had the siblings not appeared, Eltiyet would have been captured by the enemy soon. Though essentially Celestial, facing the airborne fortresses in his current state was impossible.
"Jin, and for some reason, I feel a familiar energy... This is surely Lunkandel's energy."
Luna narrowed her eyes and said. She felt a chill as soon as she sensed 'Lunkandel's energy.'
"Yes, I felt it too. Surely there can't be a traitor..."
-The flesh of Temarl possessed by the royal family is the arm.
-Arm?
-Yes, the left arm. As you may already know, the royal family is in the process of completing mind magic through it.
-How did you know they have the left arm?

-We have dealt with the royal family. From what we investigated, Temarl Lunkandel's flesh itself was no different from a collection of information on ancient peak-era magic. Though we had no proper opportunity to analyze it due to the failed deal.
Jin immediately recalled the conversation he had with Marjiella in the past.
"It seems the royal scoundrels used Temarl's left arm to create the mind."
"They've crossed the line, and then some. But saving that friend is our priority, right?"
"Yes, since the mind is with Luke, we must first push back that airborne fortress to approach it properly."
The siblings simultaneously began to rush into the battlefield.
At that moment, the battle resumed.
"Keep targeting Eltiot with the fleet; Pibil will support and take on Jin Lunekandel and Baekgyeong!" shouted Bakarun. And Luke made a different decision.
'It'll take time for those two to break through Pibil's formation and get here anyway. The priestess will open the portal again inside, so it's best to keep focusing on Pattle.'

First, Luna's red sword energy ripped through the discolored sky. The Heart Sword, Jekweol, spread across the battlefield like an irresistible counter-current, pushing away other energies and making a path.

Then, Jin's golden lightning formed huge spheres along Jekweol's trajectory. Golden Thunder Clouds from Myungwang Sword, these dozens of spheres were lightning clouds, each dropping lightning at Jin's command.
Tszuk-! Kwa-d-d-d...!
As the spheres in the sky rotated, dropping golden lightning, the enemy fleet's protective shield shattered in an instant.

Red fragments of the protective shield scattered wildly. There were sightings of ships crashing, pierced by sharp shield fragments even before being struck by lightning, but before they could finish crashing, the ensuing red sword energy and lightning ended them.
But the enemy forces were now in their prime.
In the past, they might have been powerless against the two, but Bakarun's army, with Pibil fully operational, had once been called invincible.
"Load the main cannon to maximum output; we must block their approach."
"Jeokmyeong!"

A cannon barrel protruded from the center of Pibil. As the red lightning gathered into the barrel, space warped from its power, and some shield-broken ships, unable to resist the suction, were absorbed and melted.
"Crazy bastards, using a weapon that kills their own too?" Luna prepared to parry the cannon.
"Sister, it would be best to deflect it as much as possible while approaching," said Jin.
He was right. Pibil's main cannon resembled Lam's main cannon, operated by Hyungshin in the past. It could destroy an entire force in one blow and even kill transcendent beings.
The siblings scattered to either side as the cannon exploded.
The expression 'dodge' was only possible when there was space to do so. Pibil's main cannon literally covered their entire field of vision in red.
'Neither my sister nor I are at a level that can't withstand it head-on. But there's no reason to let that happen.'
The best opponents for a fortress in the sky, even in ancient times, were overwhelmingly powerful individuals like Jin or Luna.

No matter how excellent the firepower, the sky fortress had to be slower than them. If they could close the distance while warding off the fortress's relentless omni-directional attacks, eventually someone would have to come out and stop them directly.

The siblings continued to make their way through the continuous fire from Pivill's main cannon. At times, golden energy and red sword aura penetrated the enemy's lightning and poured out in all directions.
Each time, the target was the enemy Myeong's fleet. If it weren't for Pivill, the fleet would have already been completely destroyed.
The siblings had already reduced the distance of several thousand steps by more than half.
Whether to continue operating the main cannon or fight moderately while thinking about the future, Bakarun contemplated briefly before making a decision.
"I will personally protect Pivill."
"Bakarun comrade, if it's Shimat comrade, he will say it's dangerous!"
"The communication is unstable right now, and we can't contact Pattl. How about waiting for a while until we can contact Shimat comrade?"
At the words of his comrades, Bakarun shook his head.

"If it were Rakiman comrade, maybe. But not now. If we continue to use the main cannon at maximum output, we must fight until one side dies, and we must win for sure. But who can be certain of victory right now?"
The enemy Myeong could not help but be shocked at Bakarun's thoughts.

Even though they had recreated their heyday, Bakarun, the most powerful war king, was considering defeat. Although the aerial fortress was remarkable, there were two figures like May and Eltiot, including Luna.

'That guy, like Cheongmyeong, isn't really fighting with Pattl. He's thinking about taking the emperor and running away. But if he joins with the Bamel Alliance, we could lose two more aerial fortresses before we rebuild the red sky.'
They had already been robbed by Elona.
Losing more essential forces here would ruin the hard-won opportunity for resurgence. Even if they won, it would only help other massive forces like Zifl.

Somehow, by taking care of Eltiot and retreating, the original plan of betrayal could successfully conclude, and the Myeong could finally stand on equal ground with their enemies. That's what Bakarun thought.
"Gradually reduce the output of the main cannon, but maintain enough to knock them down."
"Yes, Bakarun comrade!"
Bakarun grabbed his axe and went outside the bridge.
He planned to deal with Luna by tying Jin with the main cannon. One of the unique abilities Bakarun possessed as a war king was called 'duel'.
It was an ability to bind an enemy in a bloody sub-space during any chaotic fight. Bakarun quickly located Luna amidst the Pivill's red lightning that engulfed the front line.
As soon as Bakarun used his unique ability, Luna felt the pressure of the main cannon that had been relentlessly beating down on her disappear.

She was caught in a bloody sub-space. Luna, without panicking, first examined the characteristics of the space. The floor was filled with blood, but there were no particular toxic or dangerous elements.
"It's our first meeting, Baekgyeong. How on earth did you get involved in our fight?"
Luna unexpectedly saw Bakarun approaching from the other side and burst into a mocking smile.
"Who would play such a trick, it seems you are the Duel King of the Jeokmyeong Tribe. I've heard that Duel Kings each have a unique ability. What is your name?"
"Bakarun Yong."
"Remember it. If you survive after the battle."
Krantel produced a brilliant crimson flash. Light-speed thrust, a technique that did not suit Krantel at all, but it h
ad no significance to Luna.
Sharp, sword-like energy surged toward Bakarun's chest as if wielded by three swords. Bakarun blocked the energy with a shield, closing the distance with Luna.
The moment the axe-sword and axe clashed, Luna immediately acknowledged Bakarun.
'Surely he is the strongest of the Jeokmyeong Tribe Duel Kings; the name Hedok does come to mind.'

Bakarun had respected Luna from the start. Everything he had heard about her through wild rumors was true – no, she was even better, something he had confirmed himself when she withstood the bombardment of Pibil's main cannons.
Bakarun intended to prolong the fight as much as possible until Eltieot retreated and Pattle was secured. Since both Jin and Luna were involved, it was right to give up on the Emperor.
However, the siblings had no intention of letting things go Bakarun's way.
Zuuuuuuu...!
Suddenly, Bakarun saw the blood arena on his right side being torn apart.
Jin was entering after breaking Bakarun's unique ability with his spiritual sword.

For Bakarun, this was something he had never experienced in the long years of fighting since becoming a Duel King. No one had ever broken this ability. Even the previous Great Seal Eltieot had never breached the blood arena.
"I'm quite good at tearing things like this apart. It's almost making me feel sorry, seeing you look so flustered."
Swish-!
Jin cut into Bakarun's side as he came in. The wound was not deep, but the possibility of Bakarun defeating both was non-existent.
With no other choice, Bakarun released the blood arena, leaving himself and the siblings in the midst of Pibil's main cannons.
"Oh, you're strong and smart. Definitely different from Dreki or Rakiman."
Jin praised Bakarun as he once again cut through the reddened field of view from the cannons. Chasing Bakarun through it would be foolish.
Instead, the siblings realized that the main cannons were losing power. Now was the time to find and secure Eltieot, not Bakarun.
Finding Eltieot's location was not difficult. Jin focused his senses on detecting the faint flow of Eltieot's energy within the bombardment.
About a minute later, Jin was able to face the back of Eltieot, who was enduring the fleet's cannonade.
"You, strange brothers..."
Eltieot spoke and collapsed as he turned around to see Jin's face. He had mistaken the golden energy used by Jin as that of the Cheongmyeong tribe, even while running wild.
